name: Dead bug
steps: Lie on your back. Lift your arms toward the ceiling and bend your hips and knees to right angles.
Slowly reach one arm overhead while extending the opposite leg. Keep your lower back from arching.
Return to the start and alternate sides. Shorten the reach if your trunk moves.
cue: Keep breathing as you move slowly.

name: Plank
steps: Rest on your forearms with elbows under shoulders and legs extended.
Lift your body into a straight line and gently brace your trunk.
Breathe steadily for the prescribed time, then lower with control. End the hold if you cannot maintain your position.
cue: Do not let your hips sag or hold your breath.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and a slight bend in your knees.
Push your hips back, keeping the weights close and your spine steady. Stop before your back begins to round.
Bring your hips forward to return to standing without leaning backward.
cue: Learn the hip hinge with your trainer before adding load.

name: Goblet squat
steps: Hold one weight close to your chest with both hands. Stand with feet comfortably apart.
Bend your hips and knees together, keeping your feet planted. Lower only as far as you can control.
Stand tall again without leaning back. Keep the weight close throughout.
cue: Keep knees moving in the same direction as your toes.

name: Glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, about hip-width apart.
Gently brace your stomach and lift your hips without arching your lower back.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly to the mat.
cue: Move from your hips, not by pushing your ribs upward.

name: Bird dog
steps: Start on hands and knees, hands beneath shoulders and knees beneath hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back while keeping your trunk still.
Return slowly and change sides. Use a smaller reach if you lose balance.
cue: Keep your hips level rather than twisting to reach higher.

name: Incline push-up
steps: Place your hands on a secure bench or wall and step your feet back.
Keep your body aligned as you bend your elbows and bring your chest toward the support.
Press away with control. Use a higher support to make the movement easier.
cue: Check that the support cannot move or tip.

name: Push-up
steps: Place hands slightly wider than shoulders and extend your legs behind you.
Brace your trunk and lower your chest by bending your elbows.
Press the floor away, keeping your hips and shoulders moving together.
cue: Choose an incline variation if your lower back sags.

name: Bodyweight squat
steps: Stand with feet comfortably apart.
Sit your hips down and back while keeping feet planted.
Press through your feet to stand tall.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Reverse lunge
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and bend both knees within a comfortable range.
Push through the front foot and return to standing.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Step-up
steps: Face a stable, low step.
Place one foot fully on the step and lean slightly forward.
Press through that foot to stand on the step, then lower slowly.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Split squat
steps: Stand in a staggered stance with room to balance.
Bend both knees and lower under control.
Press through your front foot to return to the start.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Standing calf raise
steps: Stand tall near a stable support.
Rise onto the balls of your feet without rolling outward.
Pause briefly and lower your heels slowly.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Dumbbell floor press
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and weights over your chest.
Lower your upper arms gently toward the floor.
Press the weights upward without arching excessively.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
steps: Stand or sit tall with weights near shoulder height.
Press upward within a comfortable range without leaning back.
Lower the weights slowly to shoulder height.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
steps: Support one hand on a stable bench and hold a weight in the other.
Pull the elbow toward your hip without twisting your trunk.
Lower the weight slowly and repeat on the other side.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Standing band row
steps: Secure a band at chest height and hold the ends.
Pull elbows back while keeping shoulders relaxed.
Return arms forward slowly without losing posture.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Band pull-apart
steps: Hold a light band in front of your chest.
Move your hands apart while keeping your shoulders down.
Return slowly without letting the band snap back.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Dumbbell biceps curl
steps: Stand tall with weights at your sides.
Bend your elbows to raise the weights without swinging.
Lower slowly until your elbows are nearly straight.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Band triceps pressdown
steps: Secure a band overhead and hold the ends with elbows by your sides.
Straighten your elbows without moving your upper arms.
Return slowly to the starting position.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Side plank
steps: Lie on your side with elbow under your shoulder and knees bent if needed.
Lift your hips into a straight line while breathing.
Lower with control and repeat on the other side.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Standing single-leg balance
steps: Stand near a stable support.
Shift weight onto one leg and lift the other foot slightly.
Hold steadily, then switch sides.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Farmer carry
steps: Stand tall holding weights at your sides.
Walk slowly with short controlled steps and breathe normally.
Set the weights down carefully after the prescribed distance or time.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Bodyweight hip hinge
steps: Stand with knees soft and hands on your hips.
Push your hips backward while keeping your back steady.
Squeeze your hips forward to stand tall.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Wall sit
steps: Stand with your back against a stable wall.
Slide down to a comfortable knee bend with feet planted.
Breathe steadily and stand up when the hold is complete.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: Seated resistance band row
steps: Sit tall and secure a band around a stable anchor.
Pull the band toward your ribs with elbows close to your body.
Slowly extend your arms without rounding forward.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.

name: March in place
steps: Stand tall with room to move and a support nearby if needed.
Alternate lifting each knee to a comfortable height.
Keep breathing and maintain a steady controlled rhythm.
cue: Choose a comfortable range and stop if you feel pain.
